items.title: Geometric reducedness of a fibre of a space map is independent of the chosen field-valued point
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: For f : X -> Y of algebraic spaces over S and y in |Y|, the lemma proves the equivalence of: X_k geometrically reduced for some field-valued point in the equivalence class y; for every such point; and X_k reduced for every such point — the well-definedness of the geometrically reduced fibre notion at points of |Y|. The retained proof is written: by the definition of the equivalence relation on field-valued points (Properties of Spaces section points: two points are equivalent when their residue fields embed into a common extension via the fibre product), and the upward/downward transfer Spaces over Fields, lemma geometrically-reduced-upstairs (geometric reducedness ascends and reflects along field extensions for spaces over fields), the three conditions coincide; both cited sources are named and the argument is the two-line dictionary application. Retained author proof at lines 6895-6901.
